title: canVoid grants void rights to every non-admin and denies an admin listed first
evidence: Driven in Chromium: canVoid(user) for the signed-in roles [viewer, billing] returns true; canVoid({roles:['admin']}) returns false; ['viewer','admin'] returns true. Clicking Void as viewer/billing POSTed /api/invoices/void. indexOf returns -1 (truthy) when absent and 0 (falsy) at index 0.
failing_case: User sam with roles [viewer, billing] clicks Void invoice; canVoid returns true and the void request is sent. An admin whose roles array is ['admin'] is refused silently.
remediation: Use user.roles.includes('admin'). Enforce the same check on the server for /api/invoices/void; the client check is only cosmetic. Add tests for no role, admin first, admin later.

title: validQuantity accepts empty, blank, zero, negative, fractional and Infinity quantities
evidence: Driven: validQuantity returns true for '', ' ', '-5', '0', '1e3', 'Infinity', '1.5'; false only for 'abc'. Submitting a blank qty with price 5 added a line `0 × 5.00`; qty -3 at price 2 gave a displayed total of -6.00 and was POSTed.
failing_case: User leaves Quantity empty and clicks Add line: a 0-quantity line is added. User enters -3: the invoice total goes negative and is sent that way.
remediation: Validate a trimmed non-empty string with Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 and an upper bound; also require Number.isFinite(price). Test each case.

title: Double-send guard never arms: lastSend is never updated, so tooSoon() is always false
evidence: lastSend is only assigned at its declaration (guards.js:22) and never written in app.js. Driven: two quick clicks on Send produced 2 POSTs to /api/invoices. app.js:28 only increments sentCount, which nothing reads.
failing_case: User double-clicks Send invoice: two identical invoice POSTs are made and the invoice is created twice.
remediation: Set a pending flag (or disable the button) before the fetch and clear it in finally; make the server idempotent with a client-generated invoice key. Drop the dead lastSend/sentCount.

title: escapeHtml does not escape quotes, but app.js uses it inside a title="..." attribute
evidence: app.js:8 puts escapeHtml(l.client) in title="..." and assigns the result with innerHTML. Driven: client `" onfocus="window.__x=1" autofocus tabindex=0 x="` rendered as extra attributes on the <a> (title, onfocus, autofocus, tabindex, x); focusing the link set window.__x = 1.
failing_case: Client name `" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` is added (or loaded from any shared data); the link gets an onmouseover handler and runs script on hover.
remediation: Escape " and ' as well (" '), or build the DOM with createElement/textContent/setAttribute instead of innerHTML so no escaping is needed.
fix: not offerable: unbalanced brackets or quotes

title: Invalid line input is dropped silently with no error message
evidence: Traced: the early return leaves the form untouched and shows nothing. Only 'client' has the required attribute (index.html:14).
failing_case: User types price 'abc' or 0 and clicks Add line: nothing happens and no field is marked, so the user cannot tell why.
remediation: Show an inline error per field (aria-invalid plus an associated message) such as 'Unit price must be greater than 0'; clear the form after a successful add.

quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: Send has no catch for a network failure and no success feedback; empty invoices are sent
evidence: Traced: a rejected fetch (offline) throws inside the async handler, becomes an unhandled rejection and shows no message; only !res.ok is handled. On success (app.js:28) nothing is shown and lines are not cleared. Driven: with lines empty, Send POSTed '[]'.
failing_case: User goes offline and clicks Send: nothing happens, no message. On success the user sees nothing and may click again, sending a duplicate. Send with no lines posts an empty invoice.
remediation: Wrap in try/catch/finally, show 'Could not reach the server, invoice not sent' with a retry; on success show 'Invoice sent' and clear or lock the lines; disable Send when lines is empty. Set Content-Type: application/json.

title: Void is irreversible, has no confirmation, names no invoice, and shows no success or network error
evidence: Driven: one click POSTs /api/invoices/void with an empty body (no invoice id). Success shows nothing; a rejected fetch is unhandled (traced).
failing_case: User mis-clicks Void next to Send: the void request goes out immediately with no confirm and no undo, and the server cannot know which invoice is meant.
remediation: Send the invoice id, ask for confirmation naming the invoice, report success and failure (including network errors) in a status region.

title: Each client name is a link to '#' that does nothing useful
evidence: Traced: href="#" with no handler adds a focus stop per line and, when activated, appends # to the URL and scrolls to top.
failing_case: Keyboard user tabs through every line then presses Enter on one: the page jumps to the top and nothing else happens.
remediation: Render the client name as plain text, or link to a real client page.

title: aria-live on a list that is rebuilt wholesale: every Add line can re-announce all lines
evidence: Traced: app.js:7 replaces the whole list through innerHTML on each render, so screen readers may announce the entire list again.
failing_case: Screen-reader user with 10 lines adds an 11th and may hear all 11 read out again.
remediation: Append only the new <li> with aria-relevant=additions, or announce a short status such as 'Line added, total 42.00' in a separate role=status element.
